title: Odd tester acceptance identity
statement: Let $n\ge0$, let $\delta\in[0,1]$, and let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to[-1,1]$. The acceptance probability of the odd OXR tester with parameter $\delta$ equals the acceptance probability of the three-query OXR test with parameter $\delta$ applied to the odd part $x\mapsto(f(x)-f(-x))/2$.
